asset.name: Form
asset.description: The form coordination component owning values, defaults, validation timing, dirtiness, submission, autosave, server-error mapping, focus placement, and accessible status announcement.

requires.reason: Values, validation, dirtiness, and submission live in the field-granular store rather than component state.
Pending, success, failure, cancellation, and stale-result handling use the one shared async contract.
Submission outcomes are announced through the shared region.

rationale: The anchor of the domain. Validation timing is the detail that separates a professional form from a hostile one: validating on every keystroke scolds users mid-thought, and validating only on submit wastes their time.
